title: Chapter 176: Huge Fortune Pearl
content:
Chapter 176: Huge Fortune Pearl

When the ghouls see a large number of evil eyes gathering, the Zerg dragons will be afraid, so they let the ghouls rush to the front line to replace the evil eyes, so that the evil eyes retreat and focus on dealing with the Zerg dragons in the air.

The evil eyes leave the attack range of the Zerg hydralisks, and the two sides fighting on the battlefield become ghouls fighting Zerg zerglings, hydralisks and stealth spiders alone.

Because there are still a large number of evil eyes watching covetously, the Zerg dragons in the air really don't come to make trouble.

Zerg dragons, which are temporarily undefeated, are allowed to attack at will by the ghouls. I don't know if the ghouls are big and don't care about this loss at all.

As long as they don't go to the front line to make trouble, and the ghouls can fight the Zerg openly, and see the losses of the Zerg, the ghouls can feel comforted.

A large number of ghouls, ignoring the bombing of the Zerg dragons in the air, gather on the battlefield and attack the Zerg.

The casualties of Zerg puppies increased. Ghouls were indeed tough guys on the battlefield. Seeing that they were no match for Zerg puppies, they fought decisively in various ways of self-mutilation, using their own injuries and deaths to continuously inflict damage on Zerg puppies.

Through this fighting style, the ghouls accumulated small injuries into heavy damage, and finally killed the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg territory was full of troops, and Zerg puppies continuously entered the underground world to participate in the battle and replenish the losses on the front line.

Ghouls had an absolute advantage in military strength and could maintain a high-intensity attack without interruption.

The Zerg had the advantage of being able to advance and retreat freely. They could fight when they wanted to and retreat when they wanted to. They also had advantages in the combat power and types of their troops. As long as they relied on the underground world barrier and did not advance rashly, they could be invincible.

Zerg puppies, hydralisks and stealth spiders cooperated with each other to continuously expand and shrink the front line and test the best efficiency point for killing the enemy.

This best efficiency point could ensure that the system harvested as many resources as possible while the Zerg front line could be maintained for the longest time.

After the Zerg and the Ghouls fought back and forth several times on the battlefield, the Queen determined the optimal efficiency point. As long as the Ghouls maintained their current offensive state, the Zerg could fight them for a whole day.

This is a good opportunity to quickly harvest resources and vigorously develop the Zerg, which must not be missed.

Such a large underground world cannot allow the Zerg to run rampant like this.

Wu Qing and the Zerg were also lucky. The strong men of the Ghouls were all wise men, and their powerful mental attacks were just restrained by the Zerg.

If these wise men of the Ghouls were taken outside to deal with the armies of the two major camps, they would launch a mental storm attack, and thousands of troops would become fools and be directly finished.

On the battlefield of the underground world, the Queen controlled the Zerg army, cooperated perfectly, and killed the Ghouls efficiently.

The Zerg puppies were also constantly losing, and there were Zerg puppies coming from the Zerg territory to make up for it, just to maintain this balance and not be broken.

The Zerg dragons continued to wreak havoc over the ghoul territory, killing ghouls to their heart's content and destroying the bone blood pool where the ghouls were born.

Two three-star hosts and ten queens have been accompanying the Zerg dragon group, ensuring the safety of the Zerg dragon group while performing their respective tasks.

If all the Zerg dragons are lost, it means that the Zerg has lost a lot of gas resources, which is a very unprofitable deal. Wu Qing and the queen will not allow such a situation to happen.

The resources harvested from attacking the underground world, while constantly spawning Zerg puppies, must also increase the number of dragons and strive to increase the number of dragons.

For Wu Qing, the sea of dragons is more enjoyable to use than the sea of dogs.

When the Zerg fought the evil eye, Wu Qing's Zerg clones and Zerg guards rushed into the evil eye group and dealt with this strange creature at close range.

However, except for the scorching light attack, the other abilities of the evil eye were too weak. It did not bring out the strength of the Zerg clone and the Zerg guards. The evil eye could not even take half a move, so there was no point in fighting.

Wu Qing took some genetic samples of the evil eye and withdrew from the underground world.

The genes of ordinary creatures in this world are not valuable to the Zerg. The Zerg has collected the genes of countless species, and the genes of many ordinary creatures are basically the same and have no research value.

But the genes of those powerful races that have evolved and developed over a long period of time in this world have a certain research value for the Zerg.

The same is true for those alien races. Among the alien races that do not know where they came from, there are many races that the Zerg have never encountered, and their genes also have a certain research value.

Of course, for the Zerg, the genes of more powerful creatures are not necessarily better. What the Zerg needs are genes that are more suitable for the Zerg to strengthen existing arms and design practical new arms.

Otherwise, using the genes of the strong to create creatures can only be regarded as a kind of cloning and replication, which will consume a lot of resources. Except for some special cases, this kind of cloning and replication is of little significance.

On the battlefield of the Naga territory, the Queen of the Zerg has controlled the Zerg puppies on the front line and obtained the genes of the three arms of the Demon Tribe.

The Queen of the Zerg will conduct a preliminary screening of these obtained genes, find out the valuable genes, and then conduct in-depth research.

Such research will consume certain resources, but as long as there are results, it will bring great value.

For example, the biological decomposition liquid attack mode of the Zerg Hydralisk and the anti-aircraft tower was obtained by studying the giant ghoul. The results of this research have greatly improved the combat power of the Zerg.

Therefore, whenever they encounter excellent genetic samples, the Zerg will collect them for screening and research. With Wu Qing's support, this research model will continue.

The battlefield in the underground world has entered a stable state, and Wu Qing no longer needs to keep an eye on it. He handed it over to the Queen of Insects, and his consciousness came to Host No. 3 to pay attention to the affairs of the Naga territory.

…

After nearly three hours of hard work, the second batch of Zerg reinforcements arrived at the Naga territory in advance and joined the first batch of reinforcements.

The second batch of Zerg reinforcements marched without any delay, turning a blind eye to everything along the way, and marched much faster than yesterday.

When Nagaya saw that the second batch of Zerg reinforcements was larger than the first batch, she was also a little moved due to her strong psychological quality.

With these two batches of reinforcements from the Zerg tribe, the Naga tribe's crisis has truly been resolved.

How to make good use of the 300,000 Zerg reinforcements here is a question she is currently considering.

"Elder, the strength of the second batch of Zerg reinforcements exceeds our expectations, and the luck beads we raised are not enough!"

The strength of the second batch of Zerg reinforcements was larger than that of the first batch. Nagaron seemed very happy, but the luck beads he had been raising were far from enough, and his goal of owing less favors to the Zerg could not be achieved.

When the Zerg transport host came to the Naga territory, it turned off its invisibility talent, and everyone could clearly see its huge body flying at high speed in the air.

Nagaya and Nagaron also saw the transport host, and they became interested in the giant host like the Zerg. Creatures of this size are generally difficult to see.

The two led people to the front of the Zerg army and found Host No. 3.

At this time, the transport host also flew to the side of host No. 3, and two three-star hosts, one large and one small, gathered together.

"Thank you nobleman for your generous support!"

Nagaya thanked her directly.

"You're welcome. The two clans are watching each other. If the war here goes smoothly, the pressure on our clan will also be reduced!"

Wu Qing said through Host No. 3.

"Then I won't say any more, Nagaron, bring all the luck beads you have prepared!"

Nagaya ordered to Nagalon beside her.

Nagaron personally went to the back and directed the tribesmen to carry boxes of luck beads over.

There are thirty boxes in total, each with a length, width and height of about 1.5 meters. They are laid out in front of Host No. 3.

The beautifully made boxes were opened one by one, and thirty boxes were filled with boxes full of luck beads!

These luck beads were simply sorted according to size, without any more detailed packaging, and were just randomly stacked in the box, which showed the hasty preparation.

This was the first time for Wu Qing to see Qi Luck Beads of this magnitude. He made a rough estimate and found that the Qi Luck Beads here, converted into Qi resources, were at least one million or more!

These energy resources can at least add a Zerg flying dragon or a Zerg hydralisk to the Zerg!

This is a very huge wealth!

The Naga tribe just searched the army and nearby territories and found so many luck beads, which shows the depth of the Naga tribe's heritage.

Although Wu Qing was surprised, he remained calm.

"The preparations were a little hasty this time. I only raised these few luck beads, which can only be regarded as a little meeting gift!"

"In a few days, I will have someone prepare a generous thank you gift to thank the Zerg for their two aids!"

Nagaya said to Host No. 3 apologetically that in her opinion, these luck beads were completely incomparable to the nearly half a million elite Zerg army.

"These gifts are already generous!"

Wu Qing was telling the truth. The Zerg had already made enough money on the battlefield, and what the Naga gave him was pure profit. Such a gain had exceeded his expectations.

In the eyes of the Naga tribe, Wu Qing's truth was of course a polite statement from a wealthy tribe, and one would judge others by oneself. Naga and the surrounding Naga tribesmen felt that the Zerg tribe would not look down upon such a fortune bead.

The Nagas closed the box again and retreated.

It is a courtesy for the Naga people to open the box and show the gifts inside to show their openness and sincerity. It is very impolite to put things in the box and ask others to go back and open the blind box.

The transport host leaned forward a little, stretched out its long tentacles, and steadily rolled up the boxes one by one and sent them into the loading space inside it.

"This is our clan's transportation unit. We are here to transport supplies."

Wu Qing explained to Nagaya and Nagaron through Host No. 3.

The Naga tribe has a straightforward personality, and their curiosity about the transport host is written all over their faces.

"What a magical unit. The materials loaded are not outside, but inside the body!"

Nagaya was surprised by the way the transport host loaded materials.

According to common sense, it is a more reliable method for a transport host to fly with supplies wrapped in its tentacles. She did not expect that the transport host's round and huge body could actually hold things.
